test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : LNI :: QSN : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : LNI :: QSN : %

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) # = LKD, % = VML → LKD : LNI :: QSN : VML

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a40936c59f8d3de510d50608cf319928319642e73068af220eaaee9d83806658.png] 

Option 2) # = GID, % = VXS → GID : LNI :: QSN : VXS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d73650c44179af883cc68716668e885a6c65f5a9acfa70b5cc4c7481a7c976de.png] 

Option 3) # = JDD, % = VNH → JDD : LNI :: QSN : VNH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22c9d43dc9fa28a2df555bfffcf1aa3feff5854685984783158015484c3c4a8a.png] 

Option 4) # = JHD, % = MJP → JHD : LNI :: QSN : MJP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c3bbd646ab8d23561046841e23773ce5bd69f5e0a838969c892b1fc1412e320.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
